race.comment: FULMEN FILOU (4) goes well at this track and trip and won't know himself with just the 53kg after Williams' 2kg claim. Failed to give up with the 61.5kg when third in the small field over 2100m here. Gets cover from the draw and due for a change of luck. SPENZALOT (1) saves his best for this track and looks hard to stop in this weaker company. Chipped away late when no match for Kenmare Bay over 2400m at Rosehill in BM78 class. Well drawn and shapes as a leading contender. IMMORTAL ROSE (5) deserves her chance in this grade with the four wins from her last five starts. Monstered inferior opposition when she led throughout over 2100m at this track. Can surprise again. MACLEAY (3) comes into calculations after he rounded them up with ease for a big win over 1600m here. Should run the trip.
